title: The Fate of Nickelodeon’s Biggest Show Was Just Officially Confirmed
content: Throughout the history of Nickelodeon , the cable network has found success both in the worlds of live-action and animation alike. In creating the NickToons line, franchises like The Fairly OddParents, Rugrats, Hey Arnold, Rocko’s Modern Life , and Avatar: The Last Airbender have outlived their initial series finales.
author: ComicBook

title: Gravity Falls’ Dark, Spiritual Successor Hits Disney+ Later This Month
content: Gravity Falls might not be receiving a sequel series anytime soon, but this isn’t stopping Disney from creating a new macabre series that certainly seems to have the DNA of Mabel and Dipper’s misadventures.
author: ComicBook

title: New Hokuto no Ken -Fist of the North Star- Anime Casts Kazuya Ichijō
content: The staff for Hokuto no Ken -Fist of the North Star- , the new anime of Tetsuo Hara 's landmark manga Fist of the North Star ( Hokuto no Ken ), announced on Wednesday that Kazuya Ichijō is voicing Fang Father, the leader of the Fang clan. The character will appear in the anime's 12th episode this weekend.
author: ANN

title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky Anime's 3rd English-Subtitled Trailer Reveals Opening Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Nanigashi Shima and raemz 's Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky ( Tōmei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita ) novel presented the anime's third official English-subtitled trailer on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan Light Novels Get TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Wednesday to announce the television anime adaptation of writer Izushiro and illustrator Ruria Miyuki 's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan ( Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku ) light novel series.

title: The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan Anime Announced for 2027, Yuto Uemura Cast as Alus Reigin
content: Izushiro’s fantasy light novel series The Greatest Magicmaster’s Retirement Plan is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the series set to premiere in 2027. The anime revealed its first teaser visual, teaser trailer, main staff, and lead cast member.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Reveals First Trailer, Visual, and Main Cast Ahead of October Premiere
content: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life has revealed its first teaser trailer, teaser visual, main cast, and staff ahead of its October 2026 premiere. The anime was announced in February.
author: Anime Corner

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game Offers Expansion Pass DLC, Free Update in August
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday that Pokémon Pokopia , its cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémon franchise, will offer paid Expansion Pass DLC, as well as a free update in August.
author: ANN
